chunks: As for whatever is in H from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār.
He was a Kufan, a mawla of Banū Nahd, and he moved from Kufa to Basra.
Whenever Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saw him, he would say:
Give glad tidings to the humble ones.
And Ribʿī ibn ʿAbd Allāh mentioned from the one who washed al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār that he said: Indeed, I was washing al-Fuḍayl, and his hand would get ahead of me to his private parts.
He said: So I informed Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام of that, and he said: May Allah have mercy on al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār; he is one of us, the Ahl al-Bayt.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْمُخْبِتِينَ: the humble and spiritually submissive ones
key_terms.عَوْرَتِهِ: his private parts; the area to be covered
key_terms.غَاسِلِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ: the person who performed the washing of al-Fuḍayl after death

ai.seo_question: What do Shia hadith sources say about the status and virtues of al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār?
ai.summary: This report gives the transmission chain for narrations from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār and briefly records his background and spiritual rank. It presents praise from Imām Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام and Imām Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, highlighting his humility, purity, and closeness to the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Al-Husayn Al-Sadabadi, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Barqi, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar.
He was a Kufan and a freed servant (mawla) of Banu Nahd. He moved from Kufa to Basra.
Whenever Imam Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) saw him, he would say: "Give glad tidings to the humble ones."
Rabi ibn Abdullah narrated from the person who washed the body of Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar that he said: "As I was washing Al-Fudayl, his hand would move ahead of me to cover his private parts."

When this was reported to Imam Abu Abdullah (as), he said: "May Allah (swt) have mercy on Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar. He is one of us, the Ahl Al-Bayt."
